name: Cristine Bedfor
description: The reference boutique in central Maó, on Calle de la Infanta, with antique-filled interiors by Lorenzo Castillo and a garden that ranks among the city's most sought-after corners. Its restaurant is La Cocina de Cristine, led by chef Pau Sintes (European Young Chef Award 2022). Awarded a Michelin Key in 2025. Private-house luxury: the kind you only notice once you're seated in the garden.

practicalInfo.acceso: Calle de la Infanta 19, 07702 Maó, in the historic centre.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the 2026 season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 21 rooms, garden, La Cocina de Cristine restaurant (chef Pau Sintes), massages and spa, shared lounge.
